audience: PB4T training coordinators and departmental reviewers exploring a small synthetic week offline; no operational use or approved fatigue/SFTRM policy is implied.
primaryTask: Review competing departmental drill requests, save explicit synthetic constraints, find a feasible schedule, inspect changed times and personnel loading, and record a revision-specific local review.
successOutcome: Both synthetic requests appear within their permitted windows with zero independent audit violations, numeric personnel loads and an explicit current revision/review state. Infeasible and search-limit outcomes remain distinct and cannot be accepted.

screens.name: Weekly planning board
screens.purpose: A single responsive page: week and synthetic-only banner, saved/draft status, competing requests, proposed weekly allocations and current/last review. Monday through Sunday are identifiable; empty days are explicit. Before/after values are visible side by side or stacked on narrow screens.

screens.name: Inputs and constraint details
screens.purpose: Inline labeled forms for requests, exact assigned people, required qualifications, shared exclusive resources, operational windows, availability, rest and horizon duty. Advanced search budget and minute-offset editing have clear epoch/help text. Show validation and competing values without requiring raw JSON.

screens.name: Proposal review and loading
screens.purpose: Show complete allocation audit, numeric/color loading with a legend, changed times, previous accepted proposal, and unmet review requirements. Local acceptance is explicitly not operational approval. No automatic policy relaxation.

states.empty: Initially no requests or proposal; explain synthetic-only use and offer Load synthetic week. Empty days read No drills. Do not imply an empty schedule is a successful mandatory training plan.
states.loading: On local save or search, show Saving inputs or Finding feasible schedule in a live status region and prevent duplicate submissions. Yield a paint before bounded synchronous search, cap instances to 12 requests/20 starts each and search to 200000 nodes. Return to enabled controls on every outcome.
states.error: Show field-specific validation and focus the first error while preserving draft values. Render invalid input, finite-model infeasibility and inconclusive search exhaustion separately. No partial or stale proposal can be accepted. Explain specific observed constraints without claiming a minimal unsatisfiable core.
states.success: Show Feasible: all 2 requests scheduled. for the planned sample, allocated times, zero-audit summary, loads and review requirement. Accept local proposal requires a current audited proposal, saved inputs and the Review board and personnel loads checkbox. Display Locally accepted revision N; not operational approval.

persistence: Explicit Save inputs creates a new revision only if content changed. Load synthetic week on an empty store creates revision 1; loading over work opens a visible confirm/cancel prompt. Draft edits autosave separately from committed inputs. Restore both on reload when localStorage is available; disclose device-local storage. Last accepted proposal remains labeled historical after edits or failed search. Save/discard is required before review; exporting a current proposal downloads pb4t-proposal.json with synthetic classification. Storage failures show Work is not saved on this device and retain in-memory work with export available.
recovery: Correct fields without losing other draft values, or choose Discard changes to restore committed inputs. Save invalidates current proposal and prior acceptance; recalculate, audit and review anew. Show original and proposed times, people and resources before accepting. A failed search preserves the historical accepted proposal but says No current proposal to review. Retry with a larger explicit search budget or edit candidate allocations. No hard constraints are silently relaxed. Confirm replacement before loading the sample over any work.
keyboard: Use native labeled inputs, buttons, selects and checkbox with visible focus and logical Tab order: sample, editor, save/discard, search, allocations, review, export. Enter/Space activates native buttons; Escape cancels replacement confirmation and returns focus. Errors use role alert and aria-describedby; result status uses aria-live polite. Color is supplemented by text and numeric loads. Narrow layout stacks cards without hiding controls or requiring page-level horizontal scrolling.
